## Source: amazon-inspector (f05d3bc2833096e10d1893d82730f31f2288d826f76e94ce63fb5dfb356083b1)
The package slatejob 0.1.0 was examined and no indicators of installer-side harm were identified. No lifecycle network fetches, no outbound exfiltration endpoints, no credential or filesystem reads of sensitive paths, no obfuscated payloads, and no backdoor or persistence mechanisms were observed in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (779bcb94eecf53cfda39d7bfeb12aac9de072d14b22904a6f7bf55e33c3e5e7f)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
